metadata.title: CBE-0.7.0 Corrected Statistical Inference and Finite-Sample Hypothesis Audit

6h.effective_sample_size_reconciliation: Valid observations for 6h forward returns: 18282 bars. N_eff = floor(18282 / 6) = 3047 non-overlapping blocks. The legacy citation of 3124 blocks was calculated on raw 18,744 bars prior to warmup filtering.

forward_return_inference.null_hypothesis: Expected forward return is identical across all canonical market regimes (mu_1 = mu_2 = ... = mu_k)
forward_return_inference.verdict_rationale: While unadjusted ANOVA indicates statistical significance due to massive window overlap (p < 0.0001), non-overlapping subsampling yields F = 2.1217, p = 0.0600 (> 0.05). Because statistical significance is strictly method-dependent and sensitive to autocorrelation, return predictability is conservatively classified as STATISTICAL_SIGNIFICANCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

forward_risk_mae_inference.test_statistic: ANOVA F-Statistic on Maximum Adverse Excursion (MAE)
forward_risk_mae_inference.null_hypothesis: Downside risk distribution (MAE) is identical across all canonical regimes
forward_risk_mae_inference.verdict_rationale: Downside risk separation (MAE) remains statistically significant across non-overlapping subsampling (F = 19.1486, p = 0.0000) and block bootstrap due to persistent volatility clustering. This is categorized as a DESCRIPTIVE_HISTORICAL_FINDING of downside risk separation, distinguished from demonstrated investment alpha.

executive_scientific_conclusion.effective_sample_size_reconciliation: The discrepancy between 761 and 781 effective blocks for horizon 24h is resolved: 761 is the exact number of non-overlapping 24h blocks in the valid forward-looking sample space (18,264 bars), whereas 781 was an earlier calculation derived from 18,744 raw bars prior to warmup exclusion.
executive_scientific_conclusion.bootstrap_vs_subsample_p_value_resolutio: Bootstrap p-values appeared as 0.0 in Sprint 34.1 because unadjusted F (computed on 18,264 overlapping bars) was compared against null permutations, which never exceeded the inflated statistic in 500 trials. Non-overlapping subsampling eliminates the artificial degrees of freedom, revealing that forward returns are statistically indistinguishable across regimes (p = 0.8169 at 24h). Under standard finite-sample Monte Carlo principles (Davison & Hinkley, 1997), p-values are never reported as exact 0.0; plus-one Laplace correction yields p = (0 + 1) / (500 + 1) = 0.0020.
executive_scientific_conclusion.scientific_classification_summary: Forward return predictability is classified as STATISTICAL_SIGNIFICANCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Downside risk separation (MAE) is classified as DESCRIPTIVE_HISTORICAL_FINDING (not alpha). The 2025 historical dataset, having been previously inspected in Sprint 31, is treated as sealed historical evaluation data, not fresh independent validation.
